Immigration | Congressman Steven Horsford Skip to main content Image Immigration Image Congressman Horsford is fighting for comprehensive immigration reform that protects our national security while bringing families together rather than tearing them apart. Congressman Horsford is an original co-sponsor of the American Dream and Promise Act, a landmark bill that will create a path to citizenship for dreamers and protect Temporary Protected Status (TPS) holders, and Deferred Enforced Departure (DED) recipients from being forced to leave the country they love. In January 2019, Congressman Horsford presided over the House of Representatives' vote to provide $1.6 billion in funding for smart, effective, border security.   In February 2019, Congressman Horsford voted in favor of nearly $1 billion in funding to prevent the flow of illegal drugs across the U.S. border. That funding included: • $564 million to install non-intrusive inspection equipment at ports of entry • $113 million for additional air and marine assets • $100 million for new border security technology • $77 million for opioid detection equipment; and $59 million for 600 new Customs officers.   During his previous term in the House, Congressman Horsford was an original co-sponsor of the Border Security, Economic Opportunity, and Immigration Modernization Act - a bipartisan, comprehensive reform bill that would have provided a pathway to citizenship for undocumented immigrants and strengthened border security. Our Fight Against Trump's Agenda | Congressman Steven Horsford Skip to main content Image Our Fight Against Trump's Agenda Image Donald Trump’s extreme agenda is a real and growing threat to our democracy, our freedoms, and the progress we have fought so hard to secure. He has handed power to unelected billionaires, launched reckless trade wars that hurt working families, and pushed for cuts to Social Security and Medicaid — programs that millions of Americans depend on. He promised lower costs for groceries, gas, and housing, but his actions tell a different story. He is only interested in delivering tax cuts to the ultra-wealthy. I have heard your fears and frustrations. The uncertainty and instability are real — and I refuse to stand by while Nevada gets left behind. I have held this administration accountable in Congress, hosted town halls to hear from you, and introduced legislation that put Nevadans first. I am showing up every day to fight for you, and I will not stop.  Note: This information is current as of July 11, 2025, and will be updated periodically to reflect new legislative actions, letters, and initiatives. Image Town Halls Your voice is vital, now more than ever. That is why, despite Trump’s attacks on transparency, I have continued to hold town halls throughout this Congress, because every Nevadan deserves to be heard. Whether in person or virtually, I remain committed to showing up, answering tough questions, and making sure your voice shapes the work we do in Washington. Learn more about our town halls by  clicking here.   Image Letters & Legislation  Every bill I support and every letter I sign is driven by one goal: delivering real results for Nevadans. Whether it’s fighting for lower healthcare costs, protecting voting rights, securing funding for local projects, or pushing back against policies that harm our communities, I am committed to advocating for the needs of my constituents. These letters and pieces of legislation represent more than just policy. They are a direct response to the voices and concerns of the people I serve. How Medicaid Cuts Will Devastate NV-04 | Congressman Steven Horsford Skip to main content Image How Medicaid Cuts Will Devastate NV-04 Medicaid provides essential healthcare for 811,000 Nevadans , including children, seniors, and working families. The House GOP budget threatens to slash Medicaid funding, putting lives at risk and forcing many to go without critical care. These cuts would have a devastating impact: 110,334 children could lose access to doctor visits, vaccinations, and essential treatments. 16,000 seniors may lose home care, nursing home coverage, and life-saving medications. Hospitals and clinics serving low-income patients could lose funding or even close. Working families who rely on Medicaid would be forced to pay out-of-pocket for care they can’t afford. Medicaid is a Lifeline for our Community Medicaid isn’t just a program—it’s the foundation of healthcare for thousands in our district. It covers: Prenatal and pediatric care to ensure children grow up healthy. Emergency care and hospital visits for those in need. Prescription medications to manage chronic illnesses. Home health services and nursing care for aging and disabled residents. With Medicaid on the chopping block, Nevadans face higher healthcare costs, fewer doctors accepting Medicaid, and increased strain on hospitals and clinics that serve our most vulnerable populations.   Who Will Be Most Affected? If the Republican budget passes, the impact on our community will be severe: Children and families  who rely on Medicaid for doctor visits and preventive care.
